name: PowerHouse Grand Prairie campus (PowerHouse and Provident)
summary: Hyperscale data center campus planned by a PowerHouse Data Centers and Provident Data Centers joint venture on 768 to 810 acres just outside Grand Prairie in northern Ellis County, Texas. The partners plan an on-site 1.8 GW switchyard, with a first 500 MW tranche approved through ERCOT, and 24 buildings in three phases at announcement. A state accessibility filing registered in April 2026 covers Data Center Building 1, a two-story 224,152 sq ft core and shell at 881 Miller Road with an estimated cost of about USD 72.6 million and a scheduled April 2026 to April 2028 build window.

location.note: Coordinates are the Wikipedia centroid of Midlothian (s5), the mailing city in the state filing for Building 1 at 881 Miller Road (s4). The developers describe the site as just outside Grand Prairie in northern Ellis County. The street address was not geocoded.
